results.prose: Random spec draw: standards/ui/interaction.spec.md, requirement UIS-INT-05 — duplicate activation shall not produce duplicate consequential effects. That's a UI standard, but its API analog is the real-user question: what happens when a client double-sends CreateSandbox for the same name (no request_id)? The gateway rejected the duplicate with a clear already-exists error, and exactly one sandbox existed afterward — conformant.
results.steps: CreateSandbox name=X (no request_id); wait Ready; re-issue identical CreateSandbox; ListSandboxes; count instances of X; expect 1 instance and either a clear rejection or idempotent acceptance.
